annotations.title: Add, reword, remove or restore a criterion

description: Before the run: action=add (a new requirement in words; an AI call adds it), edit (new wording and/or role / standard of criterion_id), remove («Неверно»: drop it; `confirm` true when the answer warned that it is the only job-title criterion), restore («Вернуть»: undo the last change of it). The estimate is counted again. [REST: POST /api/tasks/{id}/criteria, POST /api/tasks/{id}/criteria/{cid}/edit|remove|restore]

task_id.description: The search id (task id), e.g. from list_searches or create_search.

version.description: The spec version from get_search (optional: protects against an edit made meanwhile in the web).
